ambient_events: A pneumatic tube somewhere in the walls thunks, delivers nothing, and falls silent.
Dust turns in a lamp's light over the flat-files, in no hurry to land.
The radiator ticks as it cools, thinks better of it, and ticks warm again.
description: A long civic reading room that has outlived the civics that built it. Ranks of steel flat-file cabinets line the walls, each drawer labelled in a small, precise hand. A scarred oak counter runs across the middle, worn pale where a thousand hands signed for a thousand permits. Green-shaded lamps throw honest pools of light onto blotters and index cards. It is warm, and quiet, and ordered to the point of devotion: the one room in this district that feels like someone still gives a damn about keeping the account straight.
name: Reading Room
